Please try again later.Watch laterShareCopy link0:000:00 / 0:00Live••• Event Recap | 2026 Rabobank UCI Cyclo-cross World Championships • • 30,608 views 1 month ago From 30 January to 1 February 2026, Hulst (Netherlands) proudly hosted the 𝟮𝟬𝟮𝟲 𝗥𝗮𝗯𝗼𝗯𝗮𝗻𝗸 𝗨𝗖𝗜 𝗖𝘆𝗰𝗹𝗼-𝗰𝗿𝗼𝘀𝘀 𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱 𝗖𝗵𝗮𝗺𝗽𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽𝘀. 🌈 Since 1950, these Championships have stood as the ultimate test of cyclo-cross: brutal technical circuits, unpredictable conditions, roaring crowds and the very best riders on the planet. Hulst embraced that legacy and raised the bar. Seven rainbow jerseys were awarded, including an extraordinary 8th world title for Mathieu van der Poel, further cementing his place in #CycloCross history. Next year, the UCI Cyclo-cross World Championships will return to an iconic and sandy location: Ostend! 🇧🇪 Follow the action on social media: - https://www.facebook.com/UCIcyclocross - https://www.instagram.com/uci_cycling -
